instruction: A narrow rain-slicked cyberpunk alley at night: layered neon signs in kanji and glyphs, a steaming noodle stall with a glowing canopy, tangled cables overhead, stacked AC units dripping, holographic advertisements flickering, a hovering delivery drone, wet pavement with neon reflections, and steam venting from grates between dumpsters and pipes.
user_instruction: Build a single-file three.js scene: Cyberpunk Rain Alley. A narrow rain-slicked cyberpunk alley at night: layered neon signs in kanji and glyphs, a steaming noodle stall with a glowing canopy, tangled cables overhead, stacked AC units dripping, holographic advertisements flickering, a hovering delivery drone, wet pavement with neon reflections, and steam venting from grates between dumpsters and pipes. Style: neon cyberpunk. Entirely procedural geometry and textures (no external assets; canvas-generated textures are allowed). Compose a full environment — ground/backdrop plus several distinct focal structures and rich supporting props — with style-appropriate materials, a deliberate lighting rig with shadows, atmospheric depth (fog or a gradient sky where fitting), and subtle looping animation on at least three elements. Include OrbitControls with gentle auto-rotate, ACES filmic tone mapping, and a seeded PRNG so the layout is reproducible. Target roughly 600-700 lines of well-organized code.
